# Semantic HTML

Use this skill when defining or reviewing block markup structure.

## Workflow

1. Choose semantic elements that match intent.
2. Ensure headings and landmarks are meaningful and ordered.
3. Use ARIA only where native semantics are insufficient.
4. Validate form and control relationships (labels, descriptions, grouping).
